meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用测试先行方式开发新功能并修复缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是开发时习惯先写测试、再让代码通过的工程师
copy.tagline_en: Build features and fix bugs test-first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice red-green-refactor and want tests to drive your code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按“先写失败的测试,再写刚够通过的实现”的红绿循环开发,每轮只处理一个接口、一块改动;写测试前会先与你确认要测的公共接缝(seam),并只验证行为,不碰内部实现。
howto.when: 当你想用“测试先行”的方式开发功能或修复缺陷、提到“red-green-refactor”,或想要集成测试时触发。

say.text: 用 TDD 给登录接口加个功能,先写失败测试。
say.note: Claude会先和你确认接口边界,再进入红绿循环。

say.text: 按 red-green-refactor 流程修复这个崩溃问题。
say.note: 先写复现失败的测试,再动手修。

say.text: 给订单模块写集成测试。
say.note: Claude会先列出要测的接缝并请你确认。

howto.what_en: Claude follows the red-green TDD loop: write a failing test first, then the minimal code to pass. Each cycle covers one seam and one slice; it confirms seams with you before testing and validates behavior, not internals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants test-first feature development or bug fixes, mentions "red-green-refactor", or asks for integration tests.

say_en.text: Add a login feature with TDD—write the failing test first.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the interface seam, then runs the red-green loop.

say_en.text: Fix this crash with the red-green-refactor workflow.
say_en.note: It writes a failing reproduction test before fixing.

say_en.text: Write some integration tests for the order module.
say_en.note: Claude lists the seams and checks with you before writing.
